question: In a class of 80 students, 60% are girls and the rest are boys. The average weight of boys is 5% more than that of girls. If the average weight of all the student is 51 kg, then what is the average weight (in kg) of the boys?
solution:

Total number of students = 80

Part of the students who are girls = 60%
